description: Where a window of windowDays over count loaded days, its left edge at left, moves to show the days first..last (indices): as little as it takes; for a run longer than the window, its start moving back (dir -1) or its end moving on (dir 1). Clamped to 0..count - windowDays.

cases.name: already in view: the window stays
before the window: its first day becomes the left edge
after the window: its last day becomes the right edge
longer than the window, moving back: its start shows
longer than the window, moving on: its end shows
